Reviewed official 2 Ship 2 Harkinian 5.0.0 Windows release. Upstream declares CC0-1.0; SRE bundles runtime files only, never ROMs or generated user archives. Source: https://github.com/HarbourMasters/2ship2harkinian/releases/download/5.0.0/2Ship-Battler-Alfa-Win64.zip (SHA-256 513f2899ad90b5f88221b3f2284ab45b36a34b435b1e1f273c12bc3320474dc6).
Generic fallback slot; no emulator implementation has been selected.
Catalog compatibility slot only; no adapter or redistribution decision is included in this release candidate.

SRE installed Cemu 2.6 from the official cemu-project GitHub release into the local user runtime directory (SHA-256 a6bcc2bc42a362d10213819948f3152fae7d47f70067f25939b51d3ddcfb0896). It does not bundle Cemu in SRE releases or retrieve game data, console keys, or firmware.

SRE uses the experimental bundled Ryujinx Canary 1.3.340 build for all Switch catalog entries. Windows x64 asset ryujinx-canary-1.3.340-win_x64.zip was downloaded from the Ryubing release mirror resolved by the Canary update channel and locally verified as SHA-256 6711A34979FF67DC85644E341219D0713ABF3DBEAEF6EBBCF4F13BE0588B6B65. Managed launches pass --hide-updates so Canary does not block game startup on the retired GitHub release endpoint. The previous stable Ryubing/Ryujinx runtime was removed at the user's request. SRE does not retrieve game data, keys, or firmware.
